raw.description:
Urban Walker

Walkr â London (or another city with strong walkability) Full-time / Part-time considered Â· On-site (outdoors)



About Walkr

Walkr helps people turn everyday calls and meetings into walks. We started as a small Chrome extension that flags walk-friendly meetings in Google Calendar, and we're building toward a bigger mission: make walking the default way people connect, think and work.

We believe most of what happens in a meeting room could happen just as well, if not better, on a pavement. We're now looking for someone to prove it, on the ground, every day.




The role

We're hiring a full-time Urban Walker: someone whose job is to walk. You'll take Walkr's calls, meetings and thinking sessions outdoors, on foot, in a city with enough walkable area to actually make that work. You'll be our internal proof of concept and our most honest source of product feedback.

Practically, this means:

  • Taking scheduled calls and 1:1s while walking, using Walkr to flag and organise them
  • Logging what works and what doesn't: audio quality, routes, weather, pacing, how conversations change when nobody's looking at a screen
  • Feeding that back into the product directly, you'll be in the room (or rather, on the street) with the team building the features you use
  • Scouting and mapping walkable routes near our hubs that others on the team can reuse
  • Occasionally representing Walkr in walking meetings with partners, press or early users



What we're looking for

  • You live in, or are willing to be based in, a city with genuinely walkable areas (parks, canals, low-traffic streets, decent pavements)
  • You're comfortable holding a normal, focused conversation while moving, this is a real skill, not everyone has it
  • You're organised enough to manage a calendar full of outdoor commitments and reroute around weather, meetings and life
  • You're naturally curious about behaviour change, habits and how environment shapes how we think
  • Bonus: you already walk a lot and have opinions about it



Why this role exists

Most companies talk about wellbeing and then put everyone back in a chair in a room with no windows. We'd rather have one person whose entire job disproves the excuse that walking meetings "don't really work in practice." If it's your job, it has to work.


What you'll get

  • A role that pays you to do the thing our product is trying to get everyone else to do
  • Direct input into what we build next
  • Flexible hours built around daylight and your city's best routes
  • The rare chance to put "Professional Walker" on your CV and mean it

description: St. Georgeâs University invites applicants for the position of DRIVER within the Transportation Department Job Description Objective Drivers within the transportation department are responsible for operating SGU buses to transport students, faculty, staff, and other authorized personnel, in a safe and controlled manner. Drivers play a pivotal role in enhancing the student success by providing a safe and reliable service along pre-determined routes to and from campus. The driver is expected to conduct himself in a professional manner which reflects the ethos of St. Georgeâs University. Essential Functions Communicate with passengers and employers regarding delays or any issues along a route. Complete a daily vehicle inspection sheet prior to operating any SGU vehicle. The completed sheet is to be handed to the duty supervisor once completed. Should maintenance or cleaning be required, you are to inform your supervisor immediately and list any such issues on the daily inspection form Adhere to the busing schedules Wearing issued uniform in a presentable manner Observance of all Government traffic laws and best practices which are enforced by the RGPF, All accidents, penalties and fines, as a result of driving, on and off the job, must be reported immediately to the Transportation Manager. Report all mechanical issues to management (manager or supervisor) as soon as is possible. Prior to commencing duty, ensure route destination signs reflect designated route and is clearly visible, LED & Magnetic signs should both be used. Follow all recommended health and safety practices ensuring the safety of the driver and all passengers Maintain the assigned vehicle in a clean and tidy state Any issues or concerns which involve students, faculty or staff should be reported to the transportation manager or supervisor at the earliest convenience. Confrontation with any of our passengers should be avoided. Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Since opening in 1962, The Ocean Club, A Four Seasons Resort, Bahamas has been a playground for celebrities and discerning travellers set along an 8-kilometre (5-mile) stretch of natural, white-sand beach on Paradise Island. Connect with Bahamian beauty in an enclave of remarkable seclusion, where intimate low-rise buildings are immersed in 14 hectares (35 acres) of Versailles-inspired lawns and gardens. Wake up to breakfast on your private balcony, then indulge in a restorative treatment in one of our Balinese-style spa villas or head out for a round of golf at Ocean Club Golf Course. However you spend your day, be sure to join us back at Martini Bar and Lounge for a nightcap.

When Legends Come To Life

Since opening in 1962, The Ocean Club has welcomed the worldâs most discerning guests to our five-mile stretch of natural white sand beach â framed by 35 acres of Versailles inspired lawns and gardens.

Discover the legendary chic of The Ocean Club, combining elevated Four Seasons service with laid-back Bahamian style â creating one of the most sought-after resort experiences in the Caribbean.

On a stretch of natural white sand beach, our resort offers 107 ultra-luxury accommodations, a Balinese-inspired spa, and dining by Michelin-starred chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.

The Ocean Club has a treasured history serving generations of luxury travelers. Expansive lawns and towering coconut palms provide an enchanting backdrop to the pristine beaches of Paradise Island.

The Ocean Club offers a rich roster of activities including water sports such as snorkeling, sailing and wind-surfing along with land-based activities including world-class golf and tennis plus a relaxing spa.

The Role of the Kitchen Technician

Responsible for the proper maintenance and repair of kitchen equipment throughout the property.

Key Duties And Responsibilities

  • Keeps all equipment in good repair with a minimum of downtime by providing day to day maintenance of the hotel under the direction of Engineering Management. Ensures a complete understanding of and adheres to the companyâs fire and safety procedures.
  • Continually supports and improves engineering services that effectively address problems affecting both guests and associates.
  • Trains and instructs other members of the staff by passing along knowledge and skills to assist them in their development and the advancement of your own.
  • Strives to become an independent mechanic, analyzes problems and formulates plans to get work done with a high degree of quality. Ensures that Engineering and the work area are kept clean at all times.
  • Be familiar of gas systems, and related safety procedures.
  • Maintains communications with Supervisors to ensure that all materials, tools, and supplies are available or on order. Follows up on any items that may be back ordered.
  • Responsible for the proper and timely completion of preventative maintenance systems.
  • Updates Manager regularly on assignments.
  • Performs all reasonable duties requested by management.

This is an exciting time to join The Ocean Club, a Four Seasons Resort.

Applicants that are interested in applying, please note that the position is based on The Ocean Club, A Four Seasons Resort Property located in The Bahamas and is available to those individuals who possess a legal ability to work in The Bahamas without sponsorship.

  • Perform sales report (KPIs) follow-up, identify and prioritize visual & commercial opportunities in collaboration with Store Management team
  • Create efficient and effective actions to increase customer satisfaction to reach sales targets, store goals, budget, and follow-up actions in collaboration with Store Management team
  • Follow all procedures, best practices for OMNI services, operational routines, legal requirements, and communication in all areas of the store with Store team

Fashion & Trend Awareness

description: Position Title: Produce Clerk - Full Time Position Type: Full time Job Requisition ID: 49560 Banner: Food Basics Employment Type: Permanent This position is part of a unionized bargaining unit. The hourly wage for this position starts at $18.00 - $21.35 and is established in accordance with the collective agreement. Depending on a candidateâs relevant knowledge, skills, education, and prior experience, a higher hourly wage may be offered. Any hourly wage offered for this role, whether starting or higher, will fall within the wage scale established for this position in accordance with the collective agreement. This is a posting for an existing permanent full-time position Experience a rewarding role at Food Basics as a Produce Clerk! You'll be the go-to person for ensuring our produce section is always fresh, well-stocked, and beautifully presented. Share your enthusiasm for fresh fruits and vegetables with our customers and help them find exactly what they need. Our produce team is crucial to Food Basics' success, and we're looking for energetic individuals who love working with fresh food and enjoy helping others. If you thrive in a lively environment and are passionate about quality produce, we want you on our team! What Youâll Do Unload shipments of produce and sort items in the backroom and cooler. Stock shelves and displays with fresh produce, ensuring items are rotated (first-in, first-out method) to maintain freshness. Create visually appealing displays and arrange items neatly. Inspect produce for freshness and quality, removing any damaged or spoiled items. Ensure that all produce meets the store's quality standards. Monitor temperature and humidity levels in the produce section to maintain optimal storage conditions. Assist customers with locating specific items and provide information about different produce or products in other departments. Offer recommendations on how to select and store produce. Answer customer inquiries and address concerns. Keep the produce section clean and organized, including sweeping and mopping as needed. Clean and sanitize work areas, equipment, and tools regularly. Dispose of waste and compostable materials properly. Monitor inventory levels and restock items as needed. Perform regular inventory counts and report any discrepancies. Notify management of low stock or out-of-stock items. Ensure all produce is correctly labeled with prices and product information. Update signage for promotions, sales, and seasonal items. Verify that prices in the system match the displayed prices. Reduce and price items as needed. Adhere to food safety and sanitation guidelines. Use equipment and tools safely and properly. Report any safety concerns or incidents to management. Assist with gathering shopping carts or baskets and putting them away when needed. Assist with special promotions, events, or projects as assigned by management. Collaborate with other departments as needed. Additional duties assigned by Management. Qualifications Customer service driven. Able to stock merchandise and create displays. Good product knowledge and attention to detail. Able to lift between 30 to 50 pounds. Retail experience is considered an asset. Able to stand for extend periods of time. Must be available to work flexible shifts which may include nights, weekends and holidays. The responsibilities and relationships assigned to this role may change as is necessary to achieve Metro's business objectives. Being Analytical and Meticulous

title: Wireperson
description: Description Trant Te-Tech design, custom build and install a wide range of high quality control panels, motor control centres (MCCs) and automation systems, offering conventional, intelligent and withdrawable systems with outstanding reliability and functionality. We are currently looking for a proven Wireperson to join our workshop based near Totton, Southampton. The Role The Wire Person is responsible for the accurate assembly and wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems in accordance with electrical drawings, specifications, and applicable standards. The role plays a key part in ensuring assemblies meet quality, safety, and compliance requirements prior to inspection and testing. What Youll Be Doing Technical Responsibilities - Panel & MCC Wiring Carry out wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems to approved schematics and wiring diagrams. Install and terminate power, control, and instrumentation cabling. Assemble and wire MCCs and control panels. Ensure correct segregation, routing and termination in line with design and compliance requirements. Technical Support & Collaboration Accurately interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, BOMs, and general arrangement drawings. Mark up drawings where required to reflect as-built changes. Follow work instructions and build documentation. Work collaboratively with fellow wire-people, testers, and supervisors to meet production targets. Support improvements in wiring practices, layout, and efficiency. Provide feedback to supervisors on build issues or potential improvements. SHE&Q and Compliance Carry out self-checks and peer checks prior to formal testing. Identify and report defects, non-conformances or drawing discrepancies. Work safely in accordance with company H&S procedures and UK legislation. Maintain a clean, tidy and organised working area. Use tools, equipment, and PPE correctly at all times. Key Interfaces: Internal Interfaces Workshop Supervisor. Production Manager. Test Engineer. Design & Engineering Teams. Automation Team. Stores / Logistic. Quality Team. External Interfaces Clients / Inspectors (as required) Suppliers (limited) Core Values Uphold and promote the Companys Core Values Care, Trust, Respect and Sustainability. What Were Looking For Essential NVQ Level 3 (or equivalent) in Electrical Installation, Panel Wiring, or Electrical Engineering. Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and GA drawings. Working knowledge of electrical safety practices and workshop H&S requirements. Familiarity with quality-controlled manufacturing processes. Proven experience wiring control panels, MCCs, or similar electrical assemblies. Experience terminating power, control, and instrumentation wiring. Experience working from schematics, wiring schedules, and BOMs. Experience completing work to high quality and safety standards in a workshop environment. Applicants must be legally authorised to work in the UK, as we are unable to sponsor work visas for this role. Desirable 18th Edition (BS 7671) qualification. Awareness or training relating to BS EN 61439-2:2021. Manufacturer or industry training on MCCs, switchgear andautomation systems. First Aid or IOSH Working Safely certification. Experience wiring MCCs and control panels. Experience with PLC I/O wiring, automation panels, and instrumentation. Experience supporting test and inspection activities, including rectification of faults. Experience working on custom-built, client-specific panel builds. Why Join Trant ? At Trant Engineering, we deliver complex, high-value engineering and construction projects across the UK. From process and water treatment to energy infrastructure upgrades, we play a key role in delivering and protecting critical national infrastructure shaping the systems that communities and industries rely on every day. Our teams design and deliver full EPC solutions, combining technical excellence with practical, hands-on delivery. We offer end-to-end capabilities from concept and design through to manufacturing, construction and commissioning utilising a continually evolving in-house expertise. This means youll work on projects that are varied, challenging and genuinely impactful. Our multi-disciplinary teams bring together specialists in civil, mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation, and control & automation engineering, alongside our in-house manufacturing of control panels, MCCs, PLCs and SCADA systems. With over 1,000 people and a strong, growing pipeline of work, its an exciting time to join Trant. We are committed to helping our people succeed through our Career Development Association, providing structured support, mentoring and clear pathways to help you reach your full potential. Whether youre starting out or looking to take your next career step, Trant offers the chance to develop, progress and make a real difference. Our company benefits package includes: Competitive rates. 28 days holiday (including bank holidays). Options to buy additional holiday via salary sacrifice. Company pension scheme. Employee assistance program. Discretionary annual bonus. Join us and be part of something bigger. JOB TITLE: Building Maintenance Technician


SALARY: CI$50,000 - CI$70,000 pa


WORKING HOURS: 40 HOURS PER WEEK


TERM OF EMPLOYMENT: Full-Time


We are seeking a Building Maintenance Technician to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of building infrastructure and systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation of facilities.


DO YOU HAVE:


A high school diploma (or equivalent) and a valid trade license

A minimum of 5 yearsâ experience in building maintenance within Class A Commercial properties

Strong HVAC experience in chilled water and DX systems

Training and certification in electrical, plumbing, HVAC systems maintenance, Pool Operator and Man Lift operation

A valid Cayman Islands driverâs license

The ability to operate hand and power tools required, in a safe and efficient manner

Strong knowledge of building, electrical, plumbing and MEP systems, including related equipment, tools, hazards and safety precautions

Strong communication, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills

The ability to perform physically demanding manual work for extended periods in varying and sometimes adverse conditions is required, including working in inclement weather and with regular exposure to dust and noise, as well as heavy lifting, prolonged standing, and climbing

The ability to read and interpret schematic drawings and blueprints (preferred)

A commitment to safety, continuous improvement, and professional development

Inspect, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire life safety, and other building systems

Inspect and maintain building exteriors, residential units, appliances, fixtures, pools, and site features

Support contractor coordination, disaster preparedness, and recovery activities

Communicate effectively, work collaboratively, promote a safe customer-focused environment, and demonstrate professionalism and sound judgment
